failing_checks.title: Verification of incoming authentication
failing_checks.reason: The verified artifact here is the SDP_ bearer API key. It is accepted from a cache for up to 3 minutes after the DB check that verified it, so a key revoked or whose permissions changed in that window is still accepted (the cache-hit path returns without re-running ValidateRawKeyAndUpdateLastUsed).
